checks.source_bindings: all six pinned hashes match committed Git objects

checked_coverage: fixed sequential tool names and exact arguments
raw accepted-size wrapped JSON preservation and ISO observation timestamps
valid packet strict capture_metadata interoperability with fixed unverified/pending/unchecked metadata
extra fields, boolean/unsafe revisions, uppercase UUID and trailing LF hash rejected before reads
recorder identity, reviewer kind, current owner/author and post mismatch dependent-read stopping
changed revision, unexpected current/pinned editor, and changed pinned text diagnostics
request commit/digest JSON type matrix: no reads before rejection
recorder/reviewer owner JSON type matrix: pending and one/two-read stop with null reviewer owner
real isolated journal store, identical retry, single row, exact original synthetic receipt bytes and fixed unverified/pending/unchecked/unknown metadata
limits: Host-supplied adapter is caller-controlled; synthetic/imported packets can forge equivalent responses. No signatures, host attestation or independent authenticated decision evidence established.
No live collection or raw connector response publication; no credentials, subscription/poll/ack consumer, outbox intake, shared implementation edits or deployed API/database access.
identity_revision_observed is observational only, inter-read races possible. Immutable snapshotting of a mutating host request/adapter is not audited.
Full schema/duplicate-key and canonical-size validation is explicitly deferred to journal import; response cap is UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes.
No exhaustive malicious-adapter/proxy/getter/resource/time/memory/race/crash audit. No transport timeout guarantee.

Journal storage checks are synthetic and isolated. No new live authenticated collection or replay of another worker private connector payloads. Existing regression suite supplies additional journal coverage.

disposition.market_completion: deliver review only; recipient assessment separate
disposition.implementation_review: accept for named scalar-validation and one-shot observation scope only

prior_review.history: R1 review and negative probes unchanged. This acceptance applies only to the new exact source.

finding_resolution.evidence: Source delta adds explicit typeof string checks for both request fields and both observed owner fields. Independent matrices cover null/false/true/zero/empty array/singleton array/object, plus empty-string/uppercase owner UUID. Requests reject before any read; malformed recorder/reviewer owners return pending after one/two reads. Valid string request/owner fields retain normal flow.
finding_resolution.scope: Bounded scalar-validation and retained one-shot observational behavior only; no new authority or integration approval.
